description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTimesheetMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It configures the menu for the Employee Timesheet screen within the OrangeHRM human resource management system by overriding the current module and screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet'.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures the employee timesheet menu in the HRM system by overriding the screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet' for the given Screen object.
